title: Profiles: choosing roles for your work
summary: Choose roles, compare them with access levels, and switch between intake, case work and review profiles.
scenes: Roles come from your master profile
Same place and access, different roles
Keep a role, reduce its access
Combine roles when the work needs both

steps.say: Riley handles both intake and case work in Maryland. Open My profiles using the profile box in the header.
actions: Selects “Profile Master profile Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”

steps.say: The administrator assigned two roles: Intake clerk and Case manager. Both are in Riley's master profile, at Maryland and everything under it.
onScreen: Master profile Master · Everything you have been given. Managed by your administrator. · Case manager at Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo) and everything under it · Full (read, write and delete) · Intake clerk at Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo) and everything under it · Full (read, write and delete) · In use

steps.say: A role supplies permissions for particular duties. A profile chooses which of your assigned roles to use, and where to use them.
Place sets where a grant applies. Role sets the permitted tasks. Access limits those permissions to reading, writing, or full access.
onScreen: Place · (none) · Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo) · Baltimore City Health Department · Baltimore County Department of Health · Occupational Health Program · Prince George's County Health Department · Role · Case manager · Intake clerk · Access · Read only · Read and write (no delete) · Full (read, write and delete) · Include everything under this place

steps.say: The Role list comes from your master profile. If a needed role is missing, ask your administrator; creating a profile cannot assign it to you.
For intake duties, choose Maryland, Intake clerk, and Full access. Keep everything under this place selected.
actions: Chooses “Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo)” for Place
Chooses “Full (read, write and delete)” for Access

steps.say: Full access still stays within the role's permissions. It does not make an Intake clerk a supervisor or an administrator. Save the profile.
Create a second profile for case duties, using the same Maryland place and Full access, but choose Case manager for Role.
actions: Chooses “Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo)” for Place
Chooses “Full (read, write and delete)” for Access

steps.say: Case manager includes case editing and investigation work. Intake clerk includes file upload and held-record work. Save the case profile.
Choose Use beside Maryland intake duties. The header confirms the active profile; no sign-out is needed.
onScreen: Profile · Maryland intake duties · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction

steps.say: The Intake menu is available for uploading files and handling held records.

steps.say: Switch to Maryland case duties. The place and access level stay the same, but the Intake menu disappears because Case manager lacks those intake permissions.
onScreen: Profile · Maryland case duties · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction
Home · Work queues · People · Surveillance · Registry & reports · Administration

steps.say: For a review session, create Maryland case review. Keep Case manager and the same place, but choose Read only.
actions: Chooses “Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo)” for Place

steps.say: Read only removes writing permissions from that role. It is useful when checking records without making changes. Save and use this profile.
onScreen: Profile · Maryland case review · Switch ▾ · : switch profile or jurisdiction

steps.say: People and Work queues remain available for review. The role is still Case manager; Access is what limits it to reading.

steps.say: A profile can combine roles too. Return to My profiles and create Maryland intake and cases.
actions: Selects “Profile Maryland case review Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”
Types “Maryland intake and cases” in Name

steps.say: In the first row, choose Maryland and Intake clerk, with Read and write without delete.
actions: Chooses “Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo)” for Place
Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: In the second row, choose the same Maryland place, but Case manager, also with Read and write without delete.
actions: Chooses “Maryland Lead and Metals Program (demo)” for Place
Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: The grants add together. Both sets of permissions apply; a read-only grant would not cancel writing allowed by another grant at the same place.
